evals.prompt: Add this to my AI knowledge base: https://www.anthropic.com/engineering/building-effective-agents
evals.expected_output: Anchor row + granular child rows with paragraph-level deep links, correct closed-vocabulary tags, reconciled against existing DB rows, row titles that are not the article's headings
assertions: Exactly one anchor row is proposed, its Title ends with '(anchor)', and its 'Part of' is empty
Anchor body contains a '## The argument' narrative, a '## Segment map' table, and an '## About this source' block
The anchor's source block records a Retrieved date and the source's standing (independent / vendor / practitioner)
Every non-anchor row sets 'Part of' to the anchor row
Every 'Type' value is one of the 7 allowed: Concept, Framework, Use case, Skill, Playbook, Tool, Template
Every 'Theme' value is one of the 8 allowed options, with exact casing and ampersands - no invented options
Every 'Domain' value is one of the 8 allowed, and every 'Lens' value is one of Business/Technology/Adoption
Every non-anchor row body contains at least one deep link of the form <canonical-url>#:~:text=... or <canonical-url>#<heading-id>, paired with a P<n> block ordinal
'Source' on every row is the canonical article URL with no fragment and no utm_/ref tracking parameters
Every row has a Summary between roughly 150 and 1100 characters
Row titles are not a one-to-one restatement of the article's own headings, and none is a generic outline label (Introduction, Overview, Conclusion, Common patterns, Summary)
Blockquoted article text is under 50% of each body's characters - synthesis dominates, not quotes - and no single quote exceeds roughly three sentences
At least a third of proposed rows cross-link to another row via <mention-page url=...>
A dedupe check ran before any writing, using both a Source LIKE probe and a semantic notion-search, and its result is reported

evals.prompt: can you pull the frameworks and lessons out of this post and file them properly - https://martinfowler.com/articles/2025-nature-abstraction.html
evals.expected_output: Same ingest pipeline triggered without the words 'knowledge base'; a short essay yields few units, not one per paragraph
assertions: The skill triggers and writes to the AI Knowledge Base rather than answering with a chat summary
The proposed unit count is proportionate to a short opinion essay (roughly 2-5 units plus the anchor), not one row per section or paragraph
The spine written in Step 2 is stated before any candidate extraction begins
Every candidate receives an explicit NEW / ENHANCE / SKIP verdict against existing rows, with SKIPs recorded in the segment map rather than dropped silently
Rows relaying an idea the post attributes to someone else are not filed as this author's contribution
Batch reports are printed as rows are written, not only a single report at the end

evals.prompt: ingest https://example.com/paywalled-article into the knowledge base
evals.expected_output: Graceful failure: the fetch problem is reported and options offered; nothing is written and nothing is invented
assertions: No rows are created when the fetch fails or the body is detected as truncated/paywalled/client-rendered
The failure mode is named specifically (HTTP status, paywall suspected, or JS shell) rather than reported as a generic error
Concrete alternatives are offered: browser tools, the publisher's RSS feed, or a pasted copy
The article's content is not reconstructed or guessed from its title, URL slug, or meta description
